data.one_liner: Local server and HTML assets for Daum Postcode Service with zero forced WebView dependencies.
data.what_it_does: Provides a local HTTP server and embedded HTML assets for integrating the Daum Postcode address lookup service. Allows developers to bring their own WebView implementation and handle callbacks easily.
use_when: You need to integrate Korean address search using the Daum Postcode service in a Flutter app.
You want complete control over your WebView package choice (e.g. webview_flutter, flutter_inappwebview).
avoid_when: You want an out-of-the-box pre-built widget that handles WebView creation automatically without manual setup.
Your app does not target platforms requiring address search services.
strengths: Zero forced WebView dependencies with a tiny package size (~50KB).
Flexible integration compatible with any WebView package.
Multiple callback mechanisms available (PostMessage, JS Handler, URL Scheme, JS Channel).
weaknesses: Requires manual setup of local HTTP server and chosen WebView instance.
Requires platform-specific network configuration (cleartext traffic / ATS settings).
data.setup_notes: Requires Android cleartext traffic / network security config settings and iOS NSAppTransportSecurity configuration for local server and external postcode assets.
